column1: # bin/cn_loci.tsv: the copy-number catalog, one row per locus, read by bin/copy_number.py.
# It sits in bin/ because bin/ is the only repository folder every container mounts (the bash steps
# mount it as /pgp-bin, Nextflow puts it on each task's PATH), as bin/str_intermediate_ranges.tsv.
# docs/cn-loci.md explains every column and how to add a locus; tests/test_copy_number.py checks
# every row and that no row's targets or controls overlap any region (main or paralog copy) of a
# model the pinned Parascopy data holds (assets/parascopy_models_v1.7.txt), except RHD (RHCE's
# model), the one exemption the test names. UGT2B17 has no row: pypgx calls its copy number in
# BAM mode (step 32, assets/pgx_genes.tsv).
# Coordinates are GRCh38 (no-ALT analysis set) in BED form: 0-based start, end exclusive, as
# samtools bedcov reads them. targets, controls, details: NAME:start-end[:label], separated by ";",
# all on the row's chrom. The estimate is scale x target depth / control depth - offset.
#   target_depth  sum: the target segments' mean depths added up (each is one reference unit);
#                 pooled: one length-weighted mean over all target segments
#   control_depth flanks: the mean of the control segments' means, each held to min_control_depth
#                 and to max_control_ratio against the others; pooled: one length-weighted mean
#   bedcov        the samtools bedcov options of each pass, "," between passes ("." = none); the
#                 second pass, when there is one, is the MAPQ >= 1 pass the MAPQ 0 share comes from
#   mapq0_min     a share of the target depth from reads of MAPQ 0 under which the aligner left out
#                 the reads that fit several copies: not assessed (skipped when a row without offset
#                 rounds to no copy: no read is left to judge by)
#   mapq0_max     a share above which the target is mostly misplaced reads: not assessed
#   call          round:D (a whole number within D), cut:A,B (copies = cut points reached),
#                 class:LOW,HIGH (low, typical or high from the 95% interval)
#   interval      cv: a 95% interval from the per-segment spread; "." none
#   readings      KEY=text, "|" between: per count, per class, "more" for any count above the keys
#   input         bedcov (this engine) or cnvpytor-level (CNVpytor's depth level, 1.0 = two copies)
#   owner         the engine that calls the locus; cross_check: another engine that reports it, or none
# HBA: MANE Select HBA2 NM_000517.6 and HBA1 NM_000558.5; flanks 40 kb of single-copy sequence each
#   side, outside the --SEA deletion and away from HBZ/HBZP1 and HBM.
# LPA_KIV2: exons of ENST00000316300.10 (Ensembl, checked 2026-10-25); the KIV-2 block (exons 3 to
#   16, six KIV-2 units plus the KIV-1/KIV-3 pair) against single-copy kringle exons 19 to 33.
#   scale 14 = seven reference exon pairs on two chromosomes; offset 2 = one single-copy pair each.
# RHD: Ensembl ENST00000328664; flanks outside the common RHD deletion (RHD*01N.01).
locus
HBA
column18: 0=no alpha-globin gene: the pattern of Hb Bart's hydrops fetalis (--/--); unconfirmed: this short-read count has been checked on one real genome only (HG002, four genes), so a count under four needs a clinical test before it means anything|1=one alpha-globin gene: the pattern of HbH disease (--/-a); unconfirmed: this short-read count has been checked on one real genome only (HG002, four genes), so a count under four needs a clinical test before it means anything|2=two alpha-globin genes: alpha-thalassaemia trait, either both genes lost on one chromosome (--/aa, as --SEA; a child with a partner who carries the same can have Hb Bart's) or one on each (-a/-a); depth cannot tell these apart; unconfirmed: this short-read count has been checked on one real genome only (HG002, four genes), so a count under four needs a clinical test before it means anything|3=three alpha-globin genes: one gene lost on one chromosome (-a/aa, as -a3.7 or -a4.2), a silent carrier; unconfirmed: this short-read count has been checked on one real genome only (HG002, four genes), so a count under four needs a clinical test before it means anything|4=four alpha-globin genes (aa/aa): no deletion seen|more={n} alpha-globin genes: more than four, a triplication (as aaa/aa)
